name: demo-src
description: Source for the product demo video: testreel captures the web UI, OpenAI TTS narrates, ffmpeg assembles the mp4.

scripts.capture:ui: for f in ui/*.json; do npx testreel "$f" --format mp4 || exit 1; done
scripts.speed: ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/demo.mp4 -filter_complex "[0:v]setpts=PTS/1.25[v];[0:a]atempo=1.25[a]" -map "[v]" -map "[a]" -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 18 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart out/overwrite-demo-1.25x.mp4
